description: Custom drafting, cutting, stitching, fitting, and alteration of men's, women's, and children's garments using manual and industrial lockstitch machinery in bespoke shops and micro-factories.
daily_tasks: Taking body measurements with flexible tape
Inspecting client fabric for grain line and weaving defects
Chalking cutting pattern directly on cloth
Cutting fabric with heavy tailoring shears
Iron pressing seams flat with heavy steam or coal iron
advanced_tasks: Pattern drafting for non-standard posture (stooped shoulders, scoliosis)
Lining and canvas floating in formal blazer chest pieces
Wedding lehenga multi-kali panel tapering and cancan netting insertion
materials: Cotton, silk, rayon, denim, polyester fabrics
work_processes: Measurement -> Pattern Drafting -> Fabric Cutting -> Interlining Fusing -> Assembly Stitching -> Overlocking -> Buttoning -> Trial Fitting -> Final Alteration & Pressing
troubleshooting_tasks: Balancing upper tension discs and bobbin tension to eliminate thread loops
Replacing burred needles causing skipped stitches or fabric pulls
Clearing compacted lint from feed dogs causing feed slippage
Rectifying armhole puckering by re-easing sleeve caps
quality_inspection: Checking symmetry of collar points and pocket placements
Evaluating stitch density (10–12 stitches per inch)
Confirming zero tension puckering along long side seams
measurement_and_planning: Torso length, chest, waist, hip, shoulder width, sleeve length, bicep, wrist, inseam, outseam, crotch depth
Nesting layout to maximize fabric utilization on 44-inch and 54-inch widths
safety_practices: Maintaining finger clearance behind needle guard bar
Unplugging electric irons when unattended to prevent fabric scorching/fire
Safe storage of shears in closed position
Ergonomic seating to avoid chronic lumbar strain
maintenance: Daily cleaning of bobbin case and shuttle race
Twice-weekly lubrication with clear mineral machine oil
Periodic sharpening of shears on oilstone
customer_communication: Advising on fabric drape suitability for requested designs
Discussing ease margins (loose vs slim fit)
Agreeing on delivery commitments and alteration timelines

official_vocational_references.ssc: Apparel Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council

canonical_skills: Fusible Interlining Application and Collar Stitching
Garment Pattern Measurement and Fabric Cutting
